correctness.rationale: The Fourier eigenvalue gives the exact autocorrelations. Since \(|\lambda|^2=1-3\alpha+3\alpha^2<1\), the correlation series converges and \(\tau=(1-|\lambda|^2)/|1-\lambda|^2=(1-\alpha)/\alpha\). Subtraction yields the exact gap; its denominator is positive on \((0,1)\), and its numerator has discriminant \(-12\) and positive leading coefficient.
